protocol: 200 pass-1 measured dense spectral templates; fixed weighted ridge NNLS; one train-only cutoff fit; both held-out 95/80/70 gates required before continuous replay.

validation.review: One independent read-only review: no blocker. QR, cutoff ties, train-only templates, persistence and both-held-out gating correct.

bulk_policy: Keep model, mixture plans and predictions remote; collect small report/log once with server digest verification.
next: Complete the one review, then one bounded CPU dispatch. No repetition, tuning or promotion.
limits: Same instrument/session; held-out takes are not independent-session evidence.
All 555 intended-label takes retained, including pass-3 target uncertainties.
Magnitude additivity is approximate when partials overlap coherently.
Sustain-mixture scores do not establish attacks, releases, lanes, unisons or delivered MIDI.
Ordinary reuses training takes and is descriptive stress evidence only.
Python cost is not native allocation, deadline or live latency proof.
Thirty-minute job limit bounds compute; completion time is unproven for 24,576 mixture NNLS solves plus any gated continuous replay.
